title: Text API speaks more OpenAI
summary:
A text API tune-up: better OpenAI compatibility, repaired token handling, newer reasoning, and a small nod to the long tail of the web.

The text service gained an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, while token handling was corrected for models with different completion parameter conventions. Existing OpenAI-shaped clients now have fewer reasons to notice they are talking to something else.

OpenAI reasoning support on text.pollinations.ai was updated to use o3 mini, keeping the reasoning route current without asking users to rewire their calls.

The text-to-image service received updates, and crossdomain.xml files were added for Flash-era cross-domain connections. The web remains a remarkably large compatibility surface.
